What you are investing in

A programme on the rise.

The 2026 season in highlights. Every figure below comes from Pearson's own season debrief.

6 → 13

Provincial players

Pearson players in the Eastern Cape teams, up from 6 in 2025. Two of them captained their provincial sides.

3 → 16

Wins against Punt/Outeniqua

Derby wins grew from 3 in 2025 to 16 in 2026 over 32 games.

6 → 13

Wins against Parel Vallei

Up from 6 wins in 2025, with many games decided by only one or two goals.

Runners-up → Champions

1st Team, Metro and Eastern Cape

Both titles won in 2026 after finishing second in 2025.

Season highlights

  • Eastern Cape champions. The 1st Team and the U/14s won the title, and the U/15s were runners-up.
  • Metro league. The 1st Team were Metro Champions, and the U/14, U/15 and U/16 teams were Metro runners-up.
  • Top Schools nationals. U/14s finished 11th and U/15s 16th, and the 1st Team finished 18th. The U/14s were not at nationals in 2025, and the U/15s had not qualified.
  • Fairtree rankings. The 1st Team stayed between 4th and 7th in South Africa all season, and is currently ranked 7th.
  • Paarl Girls' High Tournament. A 20–19 win over Oranje Meisieskool and a draw with Paarl Girls' High.
  • Suzuki Netball Power Series. One of only 33 schools chosen. Pearson's match was livestreamed on the SuperSport Schools App and DStv Channel 216, with commentary from the SPAR Proteas assistant coach and a SPAR Proteas player.

Built to perform

  • Expert support. A school physio, psychologist and fitness coach help players with injury prevention, rehabilitation, mental wellness and game readiness.
  • Smarter preparation. A pre-season programme at HP Gym, a Bloemfontein tour with a workshop by former SPAR Protea Karla Pretorius, and practice games against the Madibaz Men.
  • Coaching depth. Experienced outside coaches work with the teams, and coaches are placed by strength and the needs of each side.
  • Momentum off the court. The courts have been upgraded with flagpoles, court numbering and new benches, and eight sponsorships have already been secured.
  • Why cover matters. Five derby matches were lost to rain this season. The indoor court protects every fixture and training session.
The 2027 goal5 teams at Top Schools

U/14A, U/15A, U/16A, U/17A and U/19A, backed by a strong group of U/14 players joining Pearson.

Proven results. National exposure. A programme that keeps growing.This is what your partnership backs.
